message.content: {"2124_8353801511216": {"answer": "B", "reason": "Figure 1 shows a coronal reconstruction of the upper thorax where a soft tissue mass is visible adjacent to the second left rib, extending superiorly towards the clavicle and apex."}, "2124_8353801511549": {"answer": "C", "reason": "Comparing the initial upper lung mass (Figure 1) with the later CT scans (Figures 4 and 5), there is a large recurrence in the left lower lung/epidiaphragmatic region which appears significantly larger than the initial apical lesion."}, "2124_8353802248265": {"answer": "C", "reason": "Figure 4 demonstrates a large, prominent soft tissue mass located in the left epidiaphragmatic region (lower hemithorax), consistent with a significant recurrence of the tumor."}, "2124_8353802248496": {"answer": "B", "reason": "Figure 4 depicts a large, inhomogeneously enhancing mass situated in the left epidiaphragmatic region with relatively smooth margins, characteristic of the recurrent hemangiopericytoma described."}, "2124_8353802279294": {"answer": "D", "reason": "The series of images reveals multiple sites of disease: an apical mass (Fig 1), a large epidiaphragmatic mass (Fig 4), rib involvement/destruction (Fig 3), and subpleural nodules (Fig 5), indicating widespread intrathoracic recurrence."}}
